name: Creech AFB
description: Creech AFB is the hub of Air Force remotely piloted aircraft (RPA) operations, hosting MQ-9 Reaper training and operations for global strike missions.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Main Gate (Bldg 3)
gates.notes: Primary access point. Visitor Control Center located here.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required. Phone: 702-404-3694.

resources.name: Guardian Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting RPA operations with full meal service, card payments, and free WiFi. Midnight meal available.
resources.address: Voodoo Rd, Bldg 1210, Creech AFB, NV 89018

resources.name: Creech Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food options.

resources.name: Nevada Federal Credit Union
resources.description: Full-service credit union branch on base with ATM.

resources.name: Northside (Predator) Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with 24/7 access available after registration during manned hours.
resources.hours: See FSS for current hours; 24/7 access after registration
resources.address: Viper Rd, Bldg 1204, Creech AFB, NV 89018

resources.name: Southside (Reaper) Fitness Center
resources.description: Secondary fitness facility with 24/7 access via code after registration.
resources.hours: See FSS for current hours; 24/7 access after registration

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments for RPA personnel.

resources.name: Nellis Inn (AF Lodging) - No on-base lodging at Creech
resources.description: Official temporary lodging is at Nellis AFB (30 miles away). 24-hour front desk. TLF and VQ available. Reservations required.

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness. Closed first Friday of month for training.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1530; closed first Friday of month, federal holidays, ACC/15 AF Family Days
resources.address: Bldg 24, 2nd Floor, 1065 Perimeter Rd, Creech AFB, NV 89018

resources.name: 432nd Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging support, recreation, and family support programs for RPA operations.
resources.hours: See directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation (Satellite Office)
resources.description: Equipment rental by appointment, RV storage, vehicle resale lot. Full services via Nellis ODR.

resources.name: 432nd Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services supporting RPA operations.

primaryAction.title: Visitor Control Center (Main Gate)
primaryAction.address: Main Gate, Bldg 3, Creech AFB, NV 89018

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: No on-base lodging at Creech. Contact Nellis Inn (702-652-2711) for temporary lodging. Dormitory Management (702-404-1752) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 432 FSS, M&FRC, and official Creech sites for in-processing and RPA mission support.
